# THE HARMONIC LATTICE

*A complete reading, seen as a chord: the twenty-seven laid out by pitch and by
depth, and heard. A test surface, standing unlinked until it is ruled on.*

## I · THE QUESTION

A reading of three cards is small enough to hold in the mind. THE UNFOLDING is
not: all twenty-seven, each exactly once, every card of the deck standing in
some depth. The question this surface asks is what that looks like when it is
not read in sequence but seen at once, as a shape.

The answer it offers: lay each card by its **pitch** against its **depth**. The
horizontal is the spectral centroid of the card's own voice, the same
Bessel-zero arithmetic that sounds it. The vertical is the time-band the card
fell into: the root, the present, the becoming. Nothing is placed by hand.

## II · THE LAW IT HELD

No new metric was invented for the occasion. This matters more than the picture.

Both axes and both kinds of edge were already sealed elsewhere: the pitch comes
from the sounding engine, the depth from the cast, and the two lines drawn
between cards are the two relations the wheel already carries. A solid line
joins a card to its counter, its answer across the mirror. A dashed line points
a card at its becoming. The surface measures nothing that the canon had not
already measured; it only stands somewhere else to look.

That restraint is the whole of its claim. A lens that invents its own units can
show anything it likes.

## III · IT SOUNDS

The lattice does not only draw the reading. It plays it: each cell strikes its
own voice through the sealed sounding engine, so a complete reading can be
heard as well as seen. This was built into the surface from the beginning and
is easy to miss, since the toggle sits quietly beside the unfolding.

A reading heard is not a reading interpreted. The sound is the card's own
spectrum and nothing more, and no meaning is carried by it.

## IV · WHAT THE PICTURE GAVE BACK

One thing appeared that was not designed, and it is the reason this chart
exists rather than a note.

On the pitch axis, the dyads collide. The Drift stands on The Fold, The Scar on
The Return, The Spectrum on The Echo, The Gate on The Face. Their names overlap
and become hard to read, which looks at first like a fault in the drawing.

It is not a fault. It is the involution, appearing in a place nobody put it. A
card and its counter carry the same frequencies and differ only in the sign of
their beat, which the sounding engine holds as law. So on an axis of pitch
alone, a card and its answer must land at the same height. The collision is the
mirror becoming visible in sound.

Whether the labels are separated later is a question of legibility. The
coincidence beneath them stays, because it is true.

## V · WHERE IT STANDS

The surface has graduated: it stands in the Resonance room as THE UNFOLDING, where the reading is heard whole as three phrases and the air line measures its beating as it passes. [Hear it](/app/luminara-resonance.html#unfolding). The test page is retired; the history holds it.

Until 19 July 2026 this chart could name that address but not open it, because
the room described itself as texts only. The architect opened the instruments to
charts on that day, so a chart may now point at the surface it describes. The
room still casts nothing and reads nothing from the engine: a link is a
signpost, not a hand.

It is deliberately reachable from nowhere. Its own header states the terms: this
is a test, not a sealed room; if it earns its place it graduates into Resonance
or takes a room of its own, and if it does not, it is struck without ceremony.
That ruling has not been given, and this chart does not presume it.

## VI · PROVENANCE

*The surface was built on 17 July 2026 as a test prototype and left unlinked on
purpose. It entered the map room on 19 July 2026 at the architect's word, so
that a working instrument would stop being invisible while it waits. The two
axes and both edge kinds are drawn from the sealed canon and the sounding
engine, never from a measure invented here. The seeing of section IV was found
by looking at the surface running, not by design, and is recorded because the
coincidence it names is a consequence of the sounding law rather than an
accident of the drawing. Its status here is draft, matching its own account of
itself. Nothing here predicts, and nothing here prescribes.*
